# LuxEntra Media

> LuxEntra Media is a real estate media and personal branding studio in New York City. We plan, film, edit, and post content for realtors across NYC and Long Island, plus cinematic listing films and photography that turn viewers into clients.

## What we do

- Personal branding for realtors: monthly content plans, filming, editing, captions, scheduling, and publishing on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
- Real estate photography: listing photos, twilight, aerial, and interior stills.
- Real estate film: cinematic listing films and walkthrough videos.
- Podcast production: one 90 minute session at the client's location, a full episode plus up to 10 clips.

## Services and pricing

- Listing Essentials (standard package): $175
- Market Launch bundle: $399
- Listing Premiere bundle: $699
- Agent Authority bundle: $899
- Personal branding, Essential: $3,999/month, 3 month minimum
- Personal branding, Growth: $5,999/month, 3 month minimum
- Personal branding, Premium: $7,999/month, 3 month minimum
- Brand Content: $1,800/month
- Podcast episode: $1,900/episode
- Personal branding reel add-on: $499

## Areas served

New York City and Long Island: Queens, Brooklyn, Bronx, Manhattan, Nassau County, Suffolk County.
